answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A new agent locks 40 credits in escrow; its fingerprint of timing and task mix is charted in an atlas. A falcon scout samples it: staying on the narrow ledge of its fingerprint unlocks the deposit over 20 epochs; stepping off slashes it. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 × 40 = 4,000 credits, plus 100 histories faked. An honest agent pays 40 once and recovers it, keeping an undiluted reward share.
